39:t_1:3.en: ～$$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$　Captain's Cabin～

39:t_1:4.en:
$$テッサ$$
「...I'm sorry, $$カナメ$$. Given the circumstances, the $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$ will proceed straight to $$翠の地球$$.」

39:t_1:5.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Don't worry about it, $$テッサ$$. It's my fault for forcing my way aboard in the first place...」

39:t_1:6.en:
$$かなめ$$
「I'm worried about $$シンジ$$ and the others, but let's leave them to everyone on the $$ネェル・アーガマ$$.」

39:t_1:8.en:
$$かなめ$$
「I'll be fine. Besides, I was a little curious about $$翠の地球$$, so it feels like good timing.」

39:t_1:10.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Sorry. Was that a little insensitive at a time like this?」

39:t_1:12.en:
$$テッサ$$
「It's just... I was thinking... how strong you are, $$カナメ$$...」

39:t_1:14.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Yes. I thought so during the 《$$お台場の事件$$》 too... The way you stay cheerful even in adversity...」

39:t_1:15.en:
$$かなめ$$
「No, $$テッサ$$. I'm not strong at all.」

39:t_1:16.en:
$$かなめ$$
「I'm probably only smiling so carelessly now because I don't understand how terrifying the $$新地球皇国$$ really is.」

39:t_1:18.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Besides, I guess he's the reason I can be so thick-skinned. Him and everyone else.」

39:t_1:20.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Right. I think it's because I trust them to get us through any crisis.」

39:t_1:21.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Though I don't have any proof of that.」

39:t_1:22.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Then we will have to work hard to live up to your expectations, $$カナメ$$.」

39:t_1:23.en:
$$かなめ$$
「You believe it too, don't you, $$テッサ$$? That $c can win.」

39:t_1:24.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Of course. After all, I am the one in command.」

39:t_1:25.en:
$$かなめ$$
「OK! I'll take your word for it.」

39:t_1:26.en:
$$かなめ$$
「But don't push yourself too hard. You look tired, $$テッサ$$.」

39:t_1:28.en:
$$かなめ$$
「You don't have to hide it. You've got dark circles under your eyes.」

39:t_1:31.en:
$$テッサ$$
「What a relief. I couldn't show myself to $$相良$$ looking like that.」

39:t_1:33.en:
$$テッサ$$
「I'm joking. That was payback for earlier.」

39:t_1:34.en:
$$かなめ$$
「If you can say things like that, you're still doing all right.」

39:t_1:35.en:
$$かなめ$$
「But seriously, don't push yourself. Please.」

39:t_1:37.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Well, I'm off to the hangar. That guy from the maintenance crew seems to want something from me.」

39:t_1:38.en:
$$テッサ$$
「That would be Lieutenant $$サックス$$. I'm sure it's about $$アル$$.」

39:t_1:39.en:
$$かなめ$$
「It looks like we've still got time before we reach $$翠の地球$$, so get some rest until then, $$テッサ$$.」

39:t_1:40.en:
$$テッサ$$
「All right. I'll take you up on that.」

39:t_1:43.en:
$$テッサ$$
(In these past three months... how many nights have I slept without anything on my mind...?)

39:t_1:44.en:
$$テッサ$$
(The $$新地球皇国$$... $$アマルガム$$... They're both immensely powerful, and I can't fathom the full extent of either...)

39:t_1:45.en:
$$テッサ$$
(If we keep fighting, a time will come when I'm forced to make an even greater choice... When that happens, I...)

39:t_1:47.en:
$$テッサ$$
(I'll sleep for now... $$カナメ$$ went out of her way to look after me...)

39:t_1:48.en:
$$テッサ$$
(I'm sure there will be more fighting when I open my eyes... Until then, I'll give my mind whatever rest I can...)

39:t_1:52.en: ～$$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$　Hangar～

39:t_1:54.en:
$$サックス$$
「Just call me $$サックス$$. I've told you that plenty of times, $$相良$$.」

39:t_1:55.en:
$$宗介$$
「Then, Lieutenant $$サックス$$. What exactly is $$千鳥$$ doing?」

39:t_1:56.en:
$$サックス$$
「She's chatting with your partner.」

39:t_1:58.en:
$$サックス$$
「What? Did you think I'd ask a high school girl with no experience to help me with maintenance?」

39:t_1:60.en:
$$サックス$$
「Well, I can't blame you for being surprised. $$アル$$ himself asked for her.」

39:t_1:61.en:
$$宗介$$
「What on earth does $$アル$$ want with her...?」

39:t_1:64.en:
$$サックス$$
「Then let me ask you, Sergeant. Do you know everything I'm thinking?」

39:t_1:66.en:
$$サックス$$
「Same thing. Only $$アル$$ knows what he's thinking.」

39:t_1:67.en:
$$サックス$$
「Don't tell me... you still think he's just an AI?」

39:t_1:69.en:
$$サックス$$
「There you go. If $$アル$$ wants to talk to that girl, all I do is set up their date.」

39:t_1:70.en:
$$サックス$$
「Are you worried about $$アル$$ and that girl?」

39:t_1:72.en:
$$サックス$$
「Personally, I think a love triangle would be interesting. No... add one more, and we'd have a love square.」

39:t_1:74.en:
$$サックス$$
「...Sergeant... Maybe you ought to study the human heart along with $$アル$$.」

39:t_1:75.en:
$$サックス$$
(Sheesh... What does our goddess see in a dense bastard like this...?)

39:t_1:76.en:
$$宗介$$
「I'm not quite sure what you mean...」

39:t_1:77.en:
$$サックス$$
「Never mind. If you've got nothing to do, go clean the ship with your school friends.」

39:t_1:78.en:
$$サックス$$
「Our sudden trip into space left this ship a complete mess in places.」

39:t_1:80.en:
$$甲児$$
「Lieutenant $$サックス$$ is right. If you're free, give us a hand, $$宗介$$.」

39:t_1:81.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Yeah. Everyone who's free is helping with the cleaning.」

39:t_1:83.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「I might get yelled at for saying this, but I'm a little excited about going to $$翠の地球$$.」

39:t_1:84.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Me too. Our Earth was in chaos after the $$時獄戦役$$, so we hardly know anything about the other one.」

39:t_1:85.en:
$$アルト$$
「We've determined from its size and structure that it's an Earth from a parallel world, but we don't know what kind of people live there.」

notes: Kaname's unnamed he is Sousuke, confirmed by Tessa's immediate question. Sachs's goddess and the fourth romantic participant refer to Tessa; keeping goddess preserves his affectionate crew nickname. Sousuke maintains military formality despite Sachs requesting a plain name.
